title: browser.handback
description: Host -> bridge, unsolicited. The user tapped 'Done - show the agent'. Preceded by a browser.state with shared=true, handed=false, by=user. No reply.

url.description: Current page URL; may be empty if unknown.

title.description: Current page title; may be empty.

changed.description: Present only if the browser had been handed over: whether a navigation started, the URL changed, the user typed into a field, or the text fingerprint changed since the handover. Omitted when not handed over or when a fingerprint could not be taken.
